criteria.rationale: Verified stored blob sizes determine the budget, rather than materialized sizes. Tests establish clean-tree coverage and refusal of excess growth. R1 explicitly excludes expansion beyond the margin; R3 specifies margin-only disk fallback when listing fails. The 4 GiB ceiling and future retention work remain explicit spec limitations. No unresolved assumption needed for approval.

Both listing routes have a two-minute context and use the synchronized bounded-output runner with bounded pipe waiting. Read-view capture retains its existing locking and admission accounting. Deadline regressions cover governed and ungoverned routes. Test-only limit mutations occur in sequential tests and are restored.

Listing bytes and duration are bounded before retention. Snapshot excess returns a budget-naming error; listing failures prevent comparison, while disk and cleanup budgeting conservatively fall back to the margin. Negative tests exercise each affected route.

Checked the closeout-plan producer path and delegated review setup/snapshot/cleanup callers. Cleanup derives its budget from the coordinator repository and captured detached commit; governed comparison preserves read-view provenance.

Snapshot errors include the computed budget and retain GitSnapshotError context. Listing capture uses bounded diagnostics. Cleanup retains its existing operational failure and resource-retention reporting without exposing captured content.

Reviewed budget floor/ceiling arithmetic, committed-size parsing, cumulative read limits, cleanup preflight and regression assertions. Tests cover trees larger than the margin, excess materialized growth, listing overflow, deadlines and cleanup retention.

D1 addresses the actual cause: a fixed content allowance below the committed tree made complete comparison impossible. The shared tree-plus-margin calculation follows required work while retaining a ceiling. The permanent integration check binds R1-R5 to executable regression coverage.

The choice needs reconsideration when tree size reaches the absolute ceiling or retention cost dominates, as the spec records.
